criteria.text: With no Engraph executable, Rhythm remains fully functional on FTS; setup/status reports a clear install path without requiring shell or environment-variable edits.
criteria.test_id: fails closed with a sanitized message when the configured binary no longer exists

criteria.text: Discovery checks `PATH` and supported common Homebrew locations; a binary picker can choose another executable and persists only a validated path.
criteria.test_id: discoverEngraphCandidates / validateEngraphBinary

criteria.text: Rhythm creates and uses only its Application Support HOME/index; `~/.engraph` remains untouched in verified tests/manual inspection.
criteria.test_id: starts through Rhythm, proves a real <=1s authenticated search, then falls back to FTS-safe [] once disabled

criteria.text: Only the canonical agent-memory directory is indexable; arbitrary, traversal, symlink-escape, and whole-vault paths are rejected or safely normalized to the approved root.
criteria.test_id: path/root confinement (isWithinApprovedMemoryRoot)

criteria.text: Setup/indexing is asynchronous and does not block app startup or normal requests.
criteria.test_id: enable/retry/rebuild respond immediately without waiting for the (slow) lifecycle action to finish

criteria.text: Managed service access is loopback-only, authenticated, and read-only; external/non-loopback and unauthenticated access fail.
criteria.test_id: /engraph-manager — auth convention / exposes no write/content-reading endpoint

criteria.text: The health state requires a real authenticated search to complete within one second. Process existence or an open port alone is insufficient.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c7: HTTP lifecycle reaches ready only after a real authenticated <=1s search

criteria.text: Disabled, missing, unhealthy, timeout, malformed-result, or permission-blocked Engraph always falls back safely to FTS without breaking prompt construction.
criteria.test_id: returns the original FTS order when Engraph is unavailable

criteria.text: Start, shutdown, retry, and rebuild affect only the exact process Rhythm owns; no unrelated process can be terminated.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c9: HTTP start retry rebuild and shutdown preserve an unrelated process

criteria.text: Stored settings, logs, API responses, and UI-safe diagnostics contain no secrets, indexed memory content, user query text, or unnecessary sensitive path details.
criteria.test_id: sanitizeErrorMessage / never contains a secret/API-key-shaped field

criteria.text: Signed-app behavior accounts for expected Gatekeeper/TCC/notarization/signing failures without bypassing macOS protections.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c11: the notarized DMG passes a clean-user Engraph-absent FTS smoke without publishing

criteria.text: Settings presents Semantic Memory as optional, local, and fail-safe; staff can understand the status without developer knowledge.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c12: Settings presents Semantic Memory as optional local and fail-safe

criteria.text: Users can enable/disable semantic memory, request a health check/retry, open install guidance, select a binary, and request a confirmed rebuild through supported backend APIs.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c13: every supported semantic-memory action is exposed

criteria.text: The UI renders each required state/copy above from backend state and stays responsive during validation/indexing/rebuild.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c14: backend lifecycle states render without blocking the UI

criteria.text: No UI flow asks the user to edit environment variables, shell configuration, ports, tokens, or `~/.engraph`.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c15: setup guidance never asks staff for developer configuration

criteria.text: The binary picker follows existing app conventions and only submits the selected path to backend validation; the client does not trust it as healthy.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c16: selected binary is validated by the backend before enablement

criteria.text: Failure views are sanitized, actionable, accessible, and explicitly reassure users that standard memory search remains active.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c17: failure view is actionable accessible sanitized and reassuring

criteria.text: macOS permission/security failures have clear, safe guidance and do not suggest bypassing system protection.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c18: macOS security guidance preserves system protection

criteria.text: Rebuild copy and behavior make clear that only Rhythm’s Application Support index is affected.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c19: rebuild confirmation scopes deletion to Rhythm's private index

criteria.text: UI never displays indexed content, queries, auth data, secrets, or unnecessary sensitive paths.
criteria.test_id: issue-1096-c20: UI uses category guidance instead of backend sensitive fields
